reference_urls.used_for: Section order and structure only, read from the local template directory — no re-scrape needed.

sources.note: reference-libraries/concrete.json's secondary entry (agcconcrete.com) was NOT scraped — the Firecrawl MCP tool is unavailable in this session. The primary structural reference (local owl template) needed no network access, so section order/structure is unaffected. Brand colors and fonts below come directly from the client's own site CSS (curl-fetched raw HTML/CSS), not from the unreached secondary inspiration site.

brand_source: Client site stylesheet (https://tenas-concrete.b12sites.com/) — dominant button/section colors and font-family declarations, sampled via curl + regex (Playwright/Firecrawl both unavailable this session).

contrast_audit.method: WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance ratio, computed rather than eyeballed.

results.verdict: FAIL — which is why --color-on-accent is the dark ink, not white

contrast_audit.note: Client's raw accent teal #0693a9 fails white-on-fill (3.65:1) and fails outright as text on the dark primary band (1.77:1). Per the owl template's three-token accent split: --color-accent stays the raw teal as a FILL (paired with dark ink text), --color-accent-ink is a darkened teal (20% toward black) for use as text on light backgrounds, and --color-accent-on-dark is a lightened teal (75% toward white) for use as text on the dark --color-primary band.

typography.rationale: Both fonts are the client's own deliberate choices, confirmed in their site CSS: Oswald on all headings (h1-h5, uppercase, letter-spaced) and on the wordmark; Quattrocento on all body copy. Kept as-is per the brand-tokens-only extraction rule.

spacing_motion: Inherited unchanged from the owl template. No layout, spacing, or motion values were taken from the client's existing site.
anti_patterns_merged: purple / indigo / violet accents (unless explicitly requested)
generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
generic system fonts / thin starter-template feel from audit_results.json's client-site weaknesses
imagery_policy: Hero and gallery photography uses the client's own project photos (hotlinked from their existing cdn.b12.io media library — verified 200 OK) rather than stock photography. No logo image exists on the client's site (text wordmark only), so the generated site also renders a text wordmark; no logo_url is set.

_notes.cost_note: No Firecrawl scrape performed (tool unavailable this session, and the primary reference is a local directory read). All tokens sourced from a free curl fetch of the client's own homepage CSS.
